content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Meghalaya Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 17-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Meghalaya Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 17-08-2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Tech./M.E. in RF and Microwave or Wireless Communication Engineering or related disciplines, or an M.Sc. with a valid GATE/NET qualification, or be a GATE-qualified B.Tech./B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering or related disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 28 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the norms and guidelines of the Institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NIT Meghalaya Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. You need to send your complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on merit, followed by an interview, which can be conducted online or offline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is NITMGH/ECE/TTDF/6G/179/2026-2027/794.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Junior Research Fellow is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is NIT Meghalaya located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Meghalaya is located in Sohra, Meghalaya, with the pincode 793108.
